# ===== validation =====
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool) or not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a nonnegative finite float")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
    if tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")

    for name, arr in [("logp_with_result", logp_with_result),
                      ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only),
                      ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call)]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be 2-dimensional")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values (must be nonpositive)")

    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input arrays must have the same shape")

    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    if future_horizon < 1:
        raise ValueError("future horizon must be at least 1")

    # ===== compute normalized decreasing future-token weights =====
    t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=float)  # 0,1,...,future_horizon-1
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    weight_sum = np.sum(raw_weights)
    if weight_sum == 0:
        raise ValueError("All raw weights are zero; cannot normalize.")
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / weight_sum

    # ===== compute negative weighted log probability (loss) =====
    L_plus    = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    L_no_call  = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)

    # ===== stronger counterfactual baseline =====
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)

    # ===== margin and keep =====
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
